sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins before a draw, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a fixture between first and bottom place, with Alsager having managed just one win from 10 games and sitting on only 4 points, making Sandbach strong favourites to extend their excellent form.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town face a stern test at home against Dawley Town, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the standings, welcome Wednesfield Community to what should be a competitive encounter. Bilston Town, sitting sixth and in strong form with recent wins, host Foley Meir in what looks an even match-up. Shawbury United, struggling with five recent losses, host Barnton who have shown better consistency. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills in a fixture between two mid-table sides looking to climb. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom, visit Telford Town in a crucial basement battle between two sides desperate for points. Crewe, ninth in the table, host Allscott Heath in another tight encounter. Finally, Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town to what appears an uneven affair given Widnes' pointless record and severe goal difference issues.
